cohort: 176 pregnant women diagnosed with COVID-19 at a tertiary medical center
finding: Delivery was found to be safe and feasible in women with active SARS-CoV-2 infection, although there was a non-significant trend towards more severe disease and cesarean deliveries in this group.
mod_finding: A non-significant trend for increased rates of both overall cesarean delivery and urgent cesarean delivery was observed in women with an active SARS-CoV-2 infection at the time of delivery.
